reusableSystemFixesThisRun.found: The equation object ('softmax(QK^T)V') rendered with no KaTeX styling at all - flat text, no superscript, no proper spacing - in the standalone render harness.
reusableSystemFixesThisRun.diagnosis: AnimatedScene.jsx calls katex.renderToString but never imports 'katex/dist/katex.min.css' itself. CORRECTED after first writing this entry: this is NOT a live production defect. main.jsx statically imports ask.jsx (MathText's caller) at the app root, and dist/index.html confirms ask's CSS is an eager top-level <link rel="stylesheet">, present on every page load regardless of route - so a real lesson page has always rendered equations correctly. The break was specific to this benchmark's standalone render harness (scene-render-harness.jsx), which mounts AnimatedScene alone, without main.jsx's import graph, and so never pulled in that CSS. My first pass wrongly generalised a harness gap into a claimed product bug - see notes.md for the correction and why it happened.
reusableSystemFixesThisRun.fix: Added `import 'katex/dist/katex.min.css';` to AnimatedScene.jsx, next to its existing katex import. Still worth keeping even though the original urgency claim was wrong: a component that calls katex.renderToString should own its stylesheet rather than depend on a sibling component's import order, and the fix also makes this benchmark's own harness correct.
reusableSystemFixesThisRun.whyItCouldNotWait: Downgraded from the original claim. Cases 03/06/07/08 use equation objects and would have reproduced the same HARNESS-level symptom (not a product-level one), which would have made every subsequent screenshot in this run look broken for a reason that had nothing to do with the scene or the runtime being evaluated - worth fixing once, immediately, for that reason alone, independent of whether it was ever a shipped defect.
reusableSystemFixesThisRun.verification: Re-rendered this case's static-00.png after the fix - the equation now shows a correctly italicised, properly spaced softmax(QK^T)V with a real superscript T.
